structured_output.what_is_happening: A copycat "Effective Accelerationism (e/acc)" token was deployed straight onto a PumpSwap pool 12 minutes ago. It borrows the metadata of the leading e/acc coin: the packet's "website" link is usepaid.app/token/CbcyNo… (a different contract), and its X link is a Beff Jezos status. That leading coin, CbcyNo7m…, is already at about $1.6M market cap and was created about 2 hours earlier. This clone has more liquidity ($165k) than market cap ($95k), 100% of its LP unlocked, a closed creator account and 46 bundler wallets. It traded $2.1M in 12 minutes, which is about 22x its market cap, yet GeckoTerminal shows only 39 unique sellers against 1,008 sells. That pattern fits wash or bot trading around a clone pool set up for a liquidity pull.

narrative.description: Beff Jezos (Guillaume Verdon, founder of the e/acc movement) posted on X, and several e/acc tokens followed. The story itself is real and has attention in crypto and tech circles.
narrative.why_spreading: A post by a well-known figure set off a race of ticker clones. Attention has mostly settled on CbcyNo… at $1.6M.

token_connection.why_this_token: None found. Its own website link points to a different e/acc contract's page, so it looks like a metadata clone of the leader.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo7m… ($1.6M mcap, $372k h1 volume, created about 2h earlier, and the token its website link points to); 7dVWLA… ($660k, dead volume); AQJ7hZ… ($102k, $450k h1); GqmEdR… (a 2024 e/acc token)

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 46 bundler wallets. GeckoTerminal shows 1,008 sells from only 39 unique sellers. Volume is $2.1M in 12 minutes on a $95k market cap. GeckoTerminal counts 67 holders, while RugCheck says 280. Liquidity above market cap suggests a pool the deployer seeded directly, with LP 100% unlocked and the creator account closed.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the Beff Jezos post itself (X returned 402), so I cannot confirm what it endorsed. The 262 unique buyers could include some real retail buyers.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked on a pool the deployer seeded; liquidity above market cap
Creator account closed; not a pump.fun graduation (no launchpad)
46 bundler wallets; very few unique sellers relative to sell count
A clone of a leader already at $1.6M, so attention will flow to the leader

structured_output.counterargument: Clone coins sometimes catch spillover demand from traders who missed the leader. The $165k of liquidity is deep for this market cap, and price is up 41% with 262 unique buyers. If the deployer never pulls, a 2x to around $190k is quite possible in a hot e/acc wave.
